#55, following xterm's ctlseqs (DECLRMM, DECSLRM, SCOSC, DECRQSS) and xterm 411 run as a black box, which printed the same screens, cursors and replies: CSI s as SCOSC and CSI 3;7 s ignored while mode 69 is reset; DECSLRM's margins and the cursor home once it is set; an inverted and a one-column pair ignored; CSI s setting the whole width while SCORC still finds the cursor SCOSC saved; a right margin past the screen clamped; resetting mode 69 clearing the margins with the cursor left in place; DECRQSS s and DECRQM 69 after each step; not reviewed yet

#55, following the VT510 manual's DECAWM and IRM and xterm's dotext and WrapLine, and xterm 411 run as a black box, which printed the same screens and cursors: text wrapping at the right margin to the left margin, from left of the left margin too; text right of the right margin wrapping at the screen's edge; a pending wrap on the margin's column; a wrap at the bottom margin scrolling only the margins' cells; autowrap off overwriting the margin's column; REP wrapping as printing does; insert mode moving cells up to the right margin and nothing outside the margins; not reviewed yet

#55, following the VT510 manual's IND, NEL, RI and LF, ctlseqs's SU and SD, and xterm's xtermIndex and RevIndex, and xterm 411 run as a black box, which printed the same screens and cursors: LF at the bottom margin between the margins scrolling only their cells; LF, IND and NEL outside the margins leaving the screen alone; RI at the top margin scrolling down; SU and SD scrolling the region between all four margins wherever the cursor is; not reviewed yet

#55, following the VT510 manual's IL, DL, ICH, DCH, ECH and EL and xterm's InsertLine, DeleteLine, InsertChar and DeleteChar, and xterm 411 run as a black box, which printed the same screens and cursors: IL and DL moving the cells between the margins and putting the cursor on the left margin; IL and DL outside the margins doing nothing; ICH and DCH moving the cells up to the right margin and doing nothing outside the margins; ECH and EL erasing whole rows' cells whatever the margins; not reviewed yet

#55, following the VT510 manual's DECIC, DECDC, DECBI and DECFI and xterm's xtermColScroll and xtermColIndex, and xterm 411 run as a black box, which printed the same screens and cursors: DECIC and DECDC at the cursor's column in the rows of the region, up to the right margin; both doing nothing outside the region; DECBI and DECFI moving the cursor away from a margin and moving the columns at the left and right margins; DECIC on the whole screen without margins; not reviewed yet

#55, following ctlseqs's DECOM, CUP, CHA, HPA, VPA, CPR, CUF, CUB, CR, HT and CBT and xterm's CursorSet, CursorForward, CursorBack, CarriageReturn, TabToNextStop and TabToPrevStop, and xterm 411 run as a black box, which gave the same screens, cursors and CPR replies: home at the region's top left corner; CUP, CHA, HPA and VPA counting from the left margin and staying inside the margins; DECSTBM and DECSLRM homing to the corner; CUF and CUB stopping at the margins, or at the screen's edge from outside them; CR to the left margin or the first column; HT to the right margin, from right of it too; CBT to the first column outside origin mode; not reviewed yet

#55, following DEC STD 070's rectangle operations and xterm's limitedParseCol, and xterm 411 run as a black box, which printed the same screens: in origin mode DECFRA, DECCRA's source and target, DECCARA and DECERA counting columns from the left margin and clipped to the right margin; every corner is given, since xterm adds the margins twice to an omitted one, which vtium does not (vtium-term's README); not reviewed yet
